scope: Opt-in English Wikipedia main-namespace article discovery: page ID, unmodified title, word count, last-edit timestamp and constructed article attribution link. No article prose, search excerpts, images or additional page fetches.

rights.retrieval: Approved narrow Action API read/search use with identifying operator User-Agent, fixed endpoint, bounded response, maxlag and rate/throttling compliance; no API availability guarantee or white-label sublicensing.
rights.retention: Retain validated discovery metadata only in private operational job snapshots under configured job retention. Raw responses/article snippets are not persisted. No article-text corpus import/cache.
rights.display: Preserve unmodified title and article URL, Wikipedia contributor/Wikimedia attribution and CC-BY-SA licence link. Summary is first-party metadata description, explicitly not an article excerpt/evidence verification. Additional page-specific content rights are not inferred.
rights.redistribution: Discovery metadata/title attribution and licence context must travel together. Anvesha code remains Apache-2.0; do not label Wikimedia content Apache. Broader prose/media re-use requires page-specific rights/attribution review, not this manifest.
rights.evaluation: Only explicit bounded non-sensitive live acceptance and synthetic default fixtures in this slice. Any future archived real-data benchmark needs its own rights/protocol review; do not publish private queries/payloads or fabricate judgments.
rights.training: No training approved or implemented by this slice. Local inference may reorder supplied titles/generated metadata summaries under existing strict model-output validation; no URLs/tools/source prose are sent. External gateway processing needs operator policy review.

attribution: Wikipedia contributors; Wikimedia Foundation, with the discovered article URL linking to its contributor history; retain licence URL. First-party metadata summary is identified as a transformation, not quoted prose. Original first-party metadata summaries are offered under CC-BY-SA-4.0 alongside result metadata; source prose rights are not inferred.
limitations: English Wikipedia is one encyclopaedic discovery source, not general-web search or inspected evidence. No established relevance gain follows from connectivity or fixture tests.
Live selection sends original query, operator identifying User-Agent and server IP to Wikimedia; local LLM inference does not make discovery private/offline/anonymous.
No API snippets, article text, media, edit histories or article-specific source rights are retrieved. Do not generalize this grant to whole articles or model training.
Wikimedia attribution and actual upstream identity stay visible in API provenance/browser; this is a client, not a sublicensed or guaranteed Wikimedia API.
Transport uses 5-second operation timeouts and 15-second elapsed body budget; strict total trickling-header deadline, hosted quotas and in-flight cross-worker admission limits remain ANV-008.

Shared durable Wikimedia backoff handles Retry-After on 429/503/maxlag and persists across workers/restarts. Already in-flight requests cannot be recalled; paused sources return visible partial/failed jobs.

Unknown/malformed Retry-After pauses conservatively for 60s (maxlag 5s default); valid seconds/HTTP dates are honored with a minimum 1s. Unrepresentably large waits conservatively disable requests for operationally indefinite time; operators must investigate upstream instructions, not bypass throttling.
